messages.author: b55357c2dec15b2b
messages.subject: Nested association mapping population
parts:
Dear Karl,
I am working with a nested association mapping population. Is it possible to map QTLs with your programme in my population?
Will it be possible in the future to input environment to your programme or different years? 

Thanks a lot!

Tobias

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Nested association mapping population
parts:
Hi, Tobias,

There's no straightforward way to analyze NAM populations with R/qtl. I'm interested developing tools for such analyses, but I don't have immediate plans to do so.

karl
